correctness.rationale: Rebuilt GP(10,2) as 20-vertex 30-edge cubic graph. Standard two-particle discretized deleted product has (c0,c1,c2)=(190,540,375), and independently reconstructed all boundary incidences, obtaining rank ∂2=339 over F2 and F101 and ∂1∂2=0. Enumerated all 1168 unoriented simple cycles and all 823 vertex-disjoint pairs, with exactly twelve distinct length pairs. Each product-torus signed chain is an integral 2-cycle. The 36 disjoint pentagon-pair chains form a 375x36 matrix having a 36x36 integer minor determinant +1 in an independently selected row set; hence primitive in C2 and equal to ker∂2 by rational rank bound and primitive-kernel argument, proving integral H2=Z^36. All 823 tori were independently reconstructed in all 375 coordinates from this basis. Exact Smith normal forms for all twelve 36xm coordinate matrices reproduce each claimed quotient; e.g. (8,8) has 12 factors two and index 4096; (5,14) has Z^6⊕Z/2; (8,10) Z^17⊕Z/2; (9,9) Z^26. This is exhaustive for the fixed 20-vertex graph and relies on the standard deleted-product deformation equivalence, not on numerical approximation.
residual_risks: The finite enumeration is exact for the specified graph(s); no extrapolation beyond the stated objects.
